description: Golden reference answers for the fixed prompt set. Generated by hand to represent the expected output of a well-functioning incumbent model. Used by the offline quality scorer to compute cosine similarity against logged responses.
note: These are intentionally concise and correct. The scorer measures semantic similarity, not exact match. Replace with actual Q8 model outputs on your benchmark hardware if the similarity baseline drifts.
